ayahs.1: By the fig and the olive—the land of Jerusalem where prophets walked—
ayahs.2: And Mount Sinai—where Allah spoke to Musa—
ayahs.3: And this secure city—Makkah, birthplace of the final Messenger—
ayahs.4: We created humanity in the finest stature—a dignified beginning, shaped with purpose.
ayahs.5: Then We return him to the lowest of the low—
ayahs.6: Except those with iman—faith that reshapes how you live—who do righteous deeds; for them is unending reward.
ayahs.7: So what makes you deny the Judgment?
ayahs.8: Is Allah not the most just of judges?
